title: Pure Subterror
summary: Pure Subterror EARTH Flip control strategy uniting Subterror Behemoths and the Subterror Guru control core. Centered on flipping monsters face-down and face-up to trigger searching, banishing, and negation, the deck denies the opponent all proactive plays under The Hidden City.

summary.title: Starters
points: The Hidden City Field Spell adds any Subterror monster from your Deck to your hand on activation, changes a face-down Subterror monster to face-up Attack or Defense Position once per turn, and negates an opponent's attack by flipping a Subterror monster face-up.

Subterror Guru adds any Subterror card from your Deck to your hand when flipped face-up, and changes itself and 1 other face-up monster on the field to face-down Defense Position as a Quick Effect while you control another Subterror card.

Subterror Fiendess discards itself from hand and flips a face-up Subterror monster face-down to negate the activation of an opponent's card or effect, and targets a face-up Subterror to revive a Subterror monster from hand or GY.
Subterror Nemesis Warrior sends a Subterror monster from Deck to GY as a Quick Effect to tribute itself and monsters whose total Levels equal or exceed that monster's Level to Special Summon it.

summary.title: Opening: The Hidden City + Subterror Fiendess
steps: Activate The Hidden City to search Subterror Guru from your Deck.
Normal Summon Subterror Guru in face-down Defense Position.
Activate The Hidden City's effect to flip Subterror Guru face-up, triggering Guru to search Subterror Final Battle.
Set Subterror Final Battle, preparing Guru's Quick Effect book-of-moon disruption.
Keep Subterror Fiendess in hand to provide immediate omni-negation on any opponent activation.

summary.title: Bosses & Control
points: Subterror Behemoth Umastryx is a Level 7 Behemoth that targets and banishes 1 monster your opponent controls when flipped face-up.
Subterror Behemoth Stalagmo discards 1 Subterror monster when flipped face-up to draw 2 cards, rapidly cycling through your deck.
Subterror Behemoth Ultramafus changes all other face-up monsters on the field to face-down Defense Position when flipped face-up, completely shutting down Link and Synchro setups.
Subterror Behemoth Fiendess is a Link-2 monster that sends a Flip monster from Deck to GY to Special Summon a monster from hand face-down, and adds a Flip monster from Deck or GY to hand.
Subterror Nemesis Archer shuffles an opponent's face-down monster into the Deck without damage calculation when attacking, and Special Summons a Subterror monster from Deck when destroyed.

summary.title: Spells & Traps
points: Subterror Final Battle is a versatile Normal Trap that changes a Subterror monster's battle position, boosts ATK/DEF by its combined original stats, prevents Subterror effects from being negated, and Sets itself back face-down instead of going to the GY.
Subterror Succession tributes a monster to search a Flip monster of the same Attribute with a different name, and Sets itself back face-down after resolving.
Subterror Behemoth Burrowing banishes itself from the GY to protect face-down monsters you control from being targeted or destroyed by opponent card effects.
